architectural_fidelity.reason: Same beige/cream wall color maintained, window position and size preserved, ceiling height consistent, camera angle and viewpoint accurately replicated, door frame on right preserved exactly as original.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed—no trace of the white sofa, desk setup, monitors, or shelving units; clean slate achieved with no ghosting or remnants visible.

style_commitment.reason: Unmistakably farmhouse: shiplap accent wall, distressed sage dresser with vintage pulls, Edison bulb pendant and wall sconce, reclaimed wood side table, gallery wall with botanical prints—this is committed farmhouse styling, not generic neutrals.

editorial_density.reason: Gallery wall with 5 framed botanicals, open shelving styled with books and vessels, pendant lighting plus wall sconce plus recessed lighting, multiple plants, layered textiles on chair, vintage rug, accessorized surfaces—achieves AD-level lived-in detail.

photorealism.reason: Natural light casting realistic shadows, proper material textures on wood grain and fabric, Edison bulbs rendering correctly, no plastic CGI feel, cohesive lighting across all sources.

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers the requested farmhouse style with authentic material choices and layered styling while Collov's bedroom conversions (though well-executed) don't answer the home office brief.
what_cova_does_better: Executes the actual target style (farmhouse) with identifiable signature elements like shiplap and distressed furniture
Maintains room function as home office while transforming aesthetic
Authentic farmhouse material palette with sage, reclaimed wood, and Edison lighting
Preserves architectural integrity perfectly while achieving complete style transformation
what_collov_does_better: Slightly higher photorealism in fabric rendering and bedding textures
More dramatic spatial transformation showing versatility
Ceiling fan integration demonstrates architectural additions
